_doc: Un décor par terrain (le jeu prend `decors/<terrain>.png`, sinon `decors/savane.png`). Format large, recadré en 1920×1152 par `pnpm assets:dessin`.
commun: A wide background painting for a 2D animated film battle scene, no characters. Style: classic hand-drawn 2D feature animation background, 1990s look. Simple, readable shapes, soft flat color areas with gentle shading, warm sunny light from the top left. The lower third is a flat, simple, uncluttered ground where characters will stand. No characters, no animals, no text, no frame.

terrains.savane: An African savanna: flat golden grass ground, a few acacia trees in the middle distance, soft hills far away, a bright warm sky with simple rounded clouds.
terrains.plaine: Open green-gold grassland with a dirt path, a few small bushes, gentle hills far away, bright sky.
terrains.foret: The edge of a lush tropical forest: big trees and palms in the background, dappled light, flat grassy ground in front.
terrains.colline: Rolling grassy hills with rocks, a hilltop in the background, flat grassy ground in front.
terrains.montagne: Rocky mountain pass with ochre cliffs and distant peaks, flat stony ground in front.
terrains.desert: Golden sand dunes under a hot pale sky, a few dry shrubs, flat packed sand in front.
terrains.marais: Papyrus marsh with reeds and still water in the background, flat muddy ground with grass in front.
terrains.riviere: A wide calm river with reeds and palm trees on the far bank, flat sandy riverbank in front.
terrains.mer: The open sea seen from a ship: calm blue-green sea filling the lower half up to the horizon, gentle simple waves drawn as soft flat shapes, a distant coastline with a small white town and palm trees on the far left, a bright warm sky with simple rounded clouds. The lower third is flat open water where ships will float.
